description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git send-pack' command, including setup, verification, and edge case testing related to refs, stdin, and command-line arguments.

methods.name: create_ref
methods.description: Creates a git reference with the given name using a commit TREE object.

methods.name: clear_remote
methods.description: Removes the remote.git directory and reinitializes it as a bare repository.

methods.name: verify_push
methods.description: Verifies that the push to the remote has occurred correctly by comparing rev-parse outputs.
